# Font fixtures

These unmodified TrueType files are served locally by the Chrome tests and are
not production assets. Each family's SIL Open Font License is included beside it.

The files match `google_fonts` 9.0.0's catalog lengths and SHA-256 checksums.
Their download URLs are `https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/a/<sha256>.ttf`:

| File | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| ABeeZee-Regular.ttf | `0032ca8bd6534c083b32ecf7920c456d0d0a5d04edd45c6144b4bafeebb8f8e5` |
| ABeeZee-Italic.ttf | `91f9c1e6525c8f654996cae2c1fd20c3e8b9c753d5b6f957db0c337c7a929922` |
| Abel-Regular.ttf | `fbef0740397e2ca38a05f204f7129be38b2ab6bb3994a69e14d3a245e489aece` |

License sources: [ABeeZee](https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/abeezee/OFL.txt)
and [Abel](https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/abel/OFL.txt).
